sections.text: Chemical
Technical Procedure

Title
 Total Nonfiltrable Residue Dried at 103-105oC
( Total Suspended Solids )
Procedure

Using Standard Method for the Examination 
 of Water and Waste Water. (209 D) 15th Edition
Introduction

Total nonfilterable residue is the retained material on standard glass fiber 
 filter after filtration of a well mixed sample. The residue is dried at 103 to 
 105oC to a constant weight. If the suspended material clogs the filter and prolongs 
 filtration, the difference between the total residue and the total filtrable 
 residue provides an estimate of the total non-filtrable residue.

Volatile non filtrable residue and fixed non filtrable residue can be 
 determined on the material retained on the glass- fiber filters in the gooch 
 crucibles on completion of the drying at 103 to 105oC.

The first draft initiated by chem. Mohamed 
 Ahmed Farag tested by chem: Esam Abd ElAziz, reviewed by general manager 
 chemist Mohamed Kamal, revised by EDEPC quality control chemist Wael A. Tantawy, 
 approved by eng. Mokhtar Maddy: head sector of Abu Sultan PS,
 and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; general director of Admin.& 
 Financial quality control, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control Head sector.
Significance

Determination of total suspended solids in water by filtration of a well mixed 
sample. The residue is dried at 103 to 
 105oC to a constant weight. Results are reported as milligrams of 
total nonfilterable residue per liter of sample.
Safety Precautions

Store 
 sample in glass or plastic bottles.

Some evaporation residues readily absorb moisture; rapid weighing is essential. 
Some residues contain materials, such as ammonium carbonate, that 
decompose below 103oC; others contain liquids, such as glycerol and 
sulfuric acid, that will remain as a liquid residue at 103oC with or 
without solution of salts that might also be present.

3370-76.

Acids such as sulfuric acid and others are dangerous, so you 
have to wear breathing mask.

Keep these acids closed. Do not get it in the eyes, on the skin, 
or on clothing. Don't breathe them, use only in a hood.

The reagent used must be of sufficiently high purity to permit its use 
without lessening the accuracy of determination.

Apparatus

 Dishs of 100 ml capacity made of
porcelain, 90-mm diam.

c) Desiccator- 
 Provided with a desiccant containing a color 
 indicator of moisture concentration,

d) Analytical balance- 
 200 g capacity, capable of weighing to 0.1 mg,

e) Drying oven- 
 For operation at 103 -105oC and
f) Steam bath.
Reagents
Distilled water.
Work to be Carried out
Preparation of Glass Fiber Filter

Place filter 
 either on membrane filter apparatus or the bottom of a suitable gooch 
 crucible.

Apply 
 vacuum and wash filter with three successive 20-ml portion of distilled 
 water. Continue suction to remove all traces of water, and discard washings.

Remove filter from membrane filter apparatus and transfer to an aluminum or 
 stainless steel planchet as a support.
Remove crucible and filter combination if a gooch crucible is used.

Dry in an oven at 103 to 105oC 
 for 1 hr. Store in desiccator until needed. Weigh immediately before use.

sections.text: Sample Treatment

Because excessive residue on the filter may entrap water and extend drying 
 time take for analysis a sample volume that will yield between 2.5 mg and 200 
 mg total non filtrable residue as a practical limit, filter 100 ml of well mixed sample under 
 vacuum.

Wash filter with three successive 10 portions of distilled 
 water. Remove filter from membrane filter funnel assembly carefully and transfer to 
 an aluminum or stainless steel planchet as a support.

Remove crucible and filter combination from crucible adapter if a 
 gooch crucible is used.

Dry for at least 1 hr. 
 at 
 103 to 105oC, cool in desiccator to balance temperature and 
 weigh.

Repeat drying cycle until a constant weight is attained, or until weight loss 
 is less than 4% of previous weight or 0.5 mg, whichever is less.
